latest_news.headline: 15-point ceasefire plan details revealed: Iran must dismantle nuclear program, hand over uranium to IAEA
latest_news.text: Full terms of US 15-point plan published: Iran must dismantle Natanz/Isfahan/Fordo, hand 450kg 60%-enriched uranium to IAEA, abandon proxy support, limit missiles. In return: full sanctions relief, civilian nuclear support, snapback mechanism removed. Iran received points 'through mediators' — under review.

latest_news.headline: Iran eases Strait of Hormuz for 'non-hostile vessels' — US/Israel ships still blocked
latest_news.text: Iran tells global maritime authorities 'non-hostile vessels' can now transit Strait of Hormuz. US, Israel and allied-linked ships remain blocked. Partial easing of de facto blockade — first concrete sign of Hormuz de-escalation. Oil drops to $98/bbl.

latest_news.headline: Another projectile strikes Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant premises — IAEA calls for restraint
latest_news.text: Iran informs IAEA that another projectile hit Bushehr NPP premises on Tuesday. No damage to plant or staff injuries per Iran's Atomic Energy Organization. IAEA calls for 'restraint.' Second strike near nuclear facility raises escalation risk.

latest_news.headline: Iran speaker denies all negotiations; senior official says US points 'under review'
latest_news.text: Iran Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf: 'No negotiations held with US — fake news to manipulate markets.' But senior Iranian official told CBS: 'We received points from US through mediators, being reviewed.' White House says 'situation is fluid.' Gap between Iranian denial and partial acknowledgment.

latest_news.headline: Russia launches spring-summer offensive: ~400 drones, 890 troops killed in 24h
latest_news.text: ISW confirms Russia's spring-summer 2026 offensive is underway. Nearly 400 drones launched overnight. Syrskyi reports 619 Russian attacks Mar 17-20. 890 Russian KIA in 24h, 6,000+ casualties in 4 days. Ukraine deploys reinforcements. Poland scrambles jets.
